messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: Elevated p95 latency observed for /v1/generate (eu-west-1) across hosted + dedicated (since 2026-03-17T10:12:34Z). Auto-alert threshold breached (p95 > 1.8s).
oncall-anna: Acknowledged. I'm on-call — investigating. Can someone grab traces and a quick histogram for sequence lengths?
eng-runtime-jess: Pulling traces now. Seeing tail at ~2.5s primarily for long-context jobs (>3k tokens). KV-cache hit rate dropped ~22% for those routes.
sre-mike: Noted. Any abnormal autoscaler activity or GPU OOMs?
eng-runtime-jess: No OOMs. Autoscaler showing throttles on dedicated pools due to burst policy limits. A few hosts exhausted their max concurrent contexts.
oncall-anna: Initial impact: ~8% of requests in eu-west hitting p95 > 1.8s, some customers report timeouts. ETA for first mitigation ~10 minutes.
incident-bot: ACTIONS: create incident bridge -> #inc-3187654321-bridge ; notify product & support.
product-tyler: On it — prepping status page copy and customer advisory. Need concise impact + mitigation + ETA.
support-olivia: Standby to send targeted notices for customers using high-context endpoints. Please attach suggested copy.
oncall-anna: Mitigations in progress: 1) scale up dedicated pool by +2 nodes (manual) 2) enable eu-west -> eu fallback routing for non-SLA tenants 3) temporarily reduce default batching window to 8ms on busy hosts.
eng-runtime-jess: Executed scaling +2 nodes. Kicking routing change now (will keep VIPs for SLA customers pinned).
sre-mike: Reducing batching window via runtime flags:
```
# on affected hosts
export RW_BATCH_WINDOW_MS=8
rwctl restart runtime --selector=eu-west-busy
```
eng-runtime-jess: Applied to 4/6 busy hosts. Observing immediate drop in queuing.
incident-bot: METRIC UPDATE: p95 dropped from 2.1s -> 1.65s on scaled hosts (last 60s). Overall eu-west p95 now ~1.9s.
oncall-anna: Good. Still seeing a small class of long requests stuck due to KV cache miss storm. Working on cache priming + warming script.
eng-runtime-jess: Running cache-warm for top 50 prefixes for heavy customers. Script: `python tools/cache_warm.py --region eu-west --top 50` (ETA ~6m).
product-tyler: Draft status page blurb: 
"We are investigating elevated inference latency in EU (eu-west-1) affecting some requests with long context. Mitigations are in progress (scaling, routing, batching). We expect progressive recovery within 30-45 minutes. We will update customers as we validate recovery."
support-olivia: Suggested customer notice (short): 
"We're aware of increased response times for some API requests in EU. Mitigations underway. If you see errors/timeouts, please contact support with request IDs. We'll update within 30 minutes."
sre-mike: Handing off primary on-call to me in 10m. Anna — please list actions completed + open items in 1 message for handoff.
oncall-anna: Handoff summary: 
- Completed: scaled +2 dedicated nodes, routing fallback enabled for non-SLA, batching window reduced on busy hosts (4/6), cache-warm script started.
- In progress: cache warm (ETA 6m), apply batching to remaining hosts, validate pinned SLA routing remains stable.
- Open risks: cache miss storm repeating for new prefixes, potential spike in cost if scale kept for >30m.
oncall-anna: I'm switching to advisory role — Mike taking lead.
sre-mike: Taking over. New runbook steps: monitor p95, throughput, error rate; if p95 > 2s again, trigger emergency scale +4 and enable regional spill to us-east-1 for best-effort tenants.
eng-runtime-jess: Cache warm completed. Observed KV hit +17% for warmed prefixes. p95 now ~1.5s on scaled hosts; overall eu-west p95 ~1.7s.
incident-bot: NOTE: Status page updated with initial advisory (id: INC3187654321).
product-tyler: Posting the status page now and sending the short support notice. I'll attach monitoring links.
support-olivia: Sent targeted notices to 6 customers flagged as high-context users (template used). No elevated support tickets yet.
sre-mike: Monitoring for 20 more minutes for stability. If stable, we'll scale down one node in 30m and restore batching window to previous value.
oncall-anna: Thanks team. Quick postmortem checklist for later: root cause triage (why cache misses spiked), evaluate autoscaler thresholds, consider per-tenant pre-warm for heavy contexts.
product-tyler: Also will prepare customer-facing follow-up explaining mitigations + next steps for SLA customers.
sre-mike: Closing loop: leaving this thread open until we scale-down. If anyone sees regrowth of p95, ping @here.
eng-runtime-jess: No regression in last 10m, metrics stable.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: reduced alert severity to 'investigating' -> 'mitigated' (monitoring).
product-tyler: Thanks — I'll post a follow-up note in 1 hour with recovery confirmation.
support-olivia: Marking customers notified.
eng-runtime-jess: Plan for remediation: schedule a short config change to pre-warm KV for top 100 prefixes nightly and revisit batching defaults.
sre-mike: Understood. I'll own postmortem and action items. Moving to post-incident channel after scale-down.
product-tyler: Great work all. :pray:
